subject: Notice: transition planning for Maya Srinivasan
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-25T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Notice: transition planning for Maya Srinivasan

Hi Connor / Laura,

I wanted to let you know I submitted my formal resignation this morning; my last day will be April 8, 2026 (two weeks). I'm grateful for the time at Redwood and want to make the transition as smooth as possible.

Attached is a short resignation note. I'm available to draft a knowledge-transfer doc for ongoing work on the Retrieval project and to record a walkthrough of my notebooks and dataset locations.

Immediate asks:
- Can we confirm the preferred last-working-day timing (end of day 4/8)?
- Who should I send the access/inventory list to for offboarding?
- I'll need details on benefits and final payroll steps.

Thanks,

Maya
Maya Srinivasan | Senior ML Engineer
Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai

Attachment: resignation_letter.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-25T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: transition planning for Maya Srinivasan

Thanks for letting me know, Maya — I appreciate the heads up and your offer to document things. We'll make this as low-friction as possible.

Proposed plan (high level):
- Confirm last day: 2026-04-08 EOD. If HR/Legal need a different window we'll update.
- Knowledge transfer: please prepare a 1-page doc listing active experiments, important notebooks (paths), model checkpoints, and the key owners for each integration.
- Access & equipment: list any company laptop, USB keys, or test devices you have. Mina I cc'd for device recovery scheduling.
- Customer handoffs: I will draft an email to product and the two main stakeholders to reassign tasks.

Can you confirm whether you'd like to stay on a short consulting cadence after 4/8 (paid hourly) for up to 2 weeks? If yes, HR will coordinate the contracting.

I'll set up a 30-minute sync with HR and you this afternoon to confirm next steps.

-Connor
Connor O'Brien | Staff Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-25T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: transition planning for Maya Srinivasan

Thanks, Connor and Maya — sorry to see you go, Maya, and thank you for the advance notice.

Next steps from HR (summary):
1) Final pay + PTO: we'll calculate final paycheck including any accrued PTO; payroll will process on the next regular cycle.
2) Benefits & COBRA: we'll email you the benefits continuation packet and timing.
3) Severance: we have a standard severance template for role-level 3+ employees; attaching a draft severance_offer_draft.docx for Legal review.
4) Equipment: Mina will coordinate pickup or shipping of company assets.
5) Access revocation: we will schedule account deprovisioning; it typically starts after the last working day unless a different arrangement is requested.

Maya, please confirm:
- acceptance of 4/8 as last day
- whether you want to be engaged as a contractor for short-term follow-up (Connor noted this)

Markus — looping you in for severance language and any inline changes (confidentiality, return of materials, and mutual release).

Attachment: severance_offer_draft.docx

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
People & HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-26T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: transition planning for Maya Srinivasan

Laura / team — thanks for the ping. I reviewed the severance draft and recommend these edits (high level):

- Add explicit carve-out for items required by law (e.g., protected disclosures) to avoid overbroad release language.
- Clarify the effective date language and when severance payments begin (we prefer date of last paycheck + 10 business days).
- If Maya is open to a short-term consulting arrangement, include a non-employee contractor addendum (terms, hourly rate, and IP assignment for consulting work).
- Confirmation on benefit continuation language: reference COBRA vendor and contact (benefits@acme-benefits.com).

I also recommend we use DocuSign for signature and include a short FAQ for the employee so they understand timeline and tax treatment.

Thanks everyone — summary and action items:

1) Last day confirmed: 2026-04-08 EOD (Maya confirmed by phone).
2) Deliverables from Maya by EOD 2026-03-30:
   - 1-page KT doc with notebook/checkpoint paths and outstanding PRs
   - inventory of company assets in your possession
   - short bullet list of customer contacts and current status
3) Mina to schedule equipment pickup window 4/9–4/12.
4) Laura to finalize severance + DocuSign link after Legal's redlines.
5) Connor to send handoff note to Product and two stakeholder contacts by 3/26 5pm PT.

Maya — thank you again for being proactive. I'll send the handoff draft after this thread and invite you to the sync at 2:00pm today.

-Connor
